_comment: Per-site rules, for shops that do not publish standard product data.
MOST SITES NEED NO ENTRY HERE. The monitor first tries the machine-readable
product data that shops publish for Google Shopping, which works on sites
nobody has configured. Only add a site here if its row comes back blank or
wrong after a real run.
The key is the domain without 'www.'. Values are CSS selectors - the same
thing you get from right-clicking an element in a browser and choosing
Inspect. Any of the four keys may be left out.
Scrapling's adaptive mode is applied to these, so once a selector has
matched successfully it keeps working even after the shop moves the
element in a redesign.
'price' is the NORMAL price. 'sale_price' is the DISCOUNTED one, and is
only needed on shops that show both. If the sale figure is not actually
lower than the normal one it is ignored, so getting the two the wrong way
round cannot corrupt a row.
Example of a full entry:
"example-shop.com": {
"name": "h1.product-title",
"price": ".price-was",
"sale_price": ".price-now",
"in_stock": ".stock-status"
